title: Exclude single coded repairs after two or three BIT omissions
body:
With the other packet equations and all 680 endpoint rows fixed, exactly two or three nonbridge omissions cannot give a positive complete BIT invoice with one new coded nested transfer. The full pair domain has 4,125,628 members and 1,389 rank-one residuals. The triple rank filter isolates 288 rank-one residuals. Nineteen pair and nine triple replacements fit the optimistic geometry and chronology. Every one has strictly negative signed change at both trial rates.

## Task and overlap

The result refines the no-added-packet #7894 cutoff at `715ab03353bce5e1da2af2b9a15bae8f2a03eb87`. It grants free historical retention and arbitrary local XOR, keeps bridge 3553, and allows the bridge as a read-only donor. The actual old word, atlas, and complete caller grades are pinned. The scoped task is the #7852 follow-up at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, based on `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` and #7830 `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. The archive gives exact source identities and complete assumptions.

## Validation

Extract the archive, check its 44-file SHA256SUMS, then run `python3 -I -B verify.py` under Python 3.12. The isolated run finished in 69.22 seconds with about 41 MiB peak. Separate primitive replays checked all rank-one cases, 680 triple residual output rows per case, 28 directed replacement prices at two rates, and four corruption controls.

## Open next questions

Change terminal readout equations or permit multiple dependent coded transfers with separate chronology and pricing. The fixed-equations rank proof covers one added transfer.
